title: Cymulate discloses two Claude Code flaws: path restriction bypass and command injection
summary: Cymulate security researcher Elad Beber disclosed two vulnerabilities in Anthropic's Claude Code: CVE-2025-54794 (CVSS 7.7), a path restriction bypass in which prefix-based path validation let a sibling directory such as claude_code_evil pass as inside claude_code, and CVE-2025-54795 (CVSS 8.7), a command injection in which crafted input to a whitelisted command such as echo closed the string and ran extra shell commands without a user prompt. Anthropic fixed them in versions 0.2.111 and 1.0.20; the post reports no exploitation in the wild and notes that practical exploitation of the command injection requires Claude Code to run with elevated privileges and be exposed to untrusted input or code.
